selectedIdea.angle: Show what the evidence says about ocean.

synthesis.factHandoff: The global ocean covers 71% of Earth's surface and is divided geographically into named regions.

narrative.content:
Kern van het verhaal
De namen op de kaart verdelen één wereldzee in regio’s.

Redactionele insteek
Licht dit feit in gewone taal toe.

source: one global ocean, the vast body of water that covers 71 percent of the Earth is geographically divided into distinct named regions.
